name: shell-click
title: Shell Click
description: Companion extension for Shell Click (https://shellclick.dev): search and run saved commands, switch workspaces, and manage listening ports. Requires the Shell Click macOS app.
author: Envl

commands.name: palette
commands.title: Search Command
commands.description: Search Shell Click commands and open their actions

preferences.name: applicationBundlePath
preferences.title: Shell Click App Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to ShellClick.app. Leave blank to find an installed copy.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Use npm run publish to submit to the Raycast Store.'); process.exit(1)"
